subject.title: feat: disable automatic session resets by default

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `session.reset.mode: "none"` as the upgrade default for all previously unconfigured sessions after the lifecycle defects are corrected?
rationale: This is a deliberate global compatibility and session-continuity policy change; tests can verify mechanics but cannot choose the desired default for existing operators.

options.title: Adopt rolling continuity by default
options.body: Keep the `none` default after the two lifecycle fixes and after real runtime evidence shows explicit daily and idle policies continue to roll sessions correctly.

options.title: Retain daily rollover as the default
options.body: Keep current unconfigured-session behavior and offer rolling continuity only through an explicit configuration choice.

recommendation.title: Adopt rolling continuity by default
recommendation.body: Keep the `none` default after the two lifecycle fixes and after real runtime evidence shows explicit daily and idle policies continue to roll sessions correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR states the direction is owner-approved and steipete authored the current session-reset implementation changes.
